title: agent_events input
description: Query parameters: which of the agent's events to read. Reading never acknowledges them.

after.description: Return events after this seq. Omitted: after the agent's acknowledged cursor.

type.description: Only events of this kind: need (needs posted, their replies), connection, message (messages and outreach) or call (executions and engagements).

limit.description: The most events to return; values outside 1 to 200 are brought within it.
